method: Browser UI actions and DOM/screenshot observations on localhost:8084; separate origin from existing development configurations.

checks.name: Pause
checks.observed: PAUSED and Play controls; pause retained after restore and quality reload.

checks.name: Wind control / developed sea
checks.observed: Set 9.3 m/s, apply developed sea; saved/share URL contains windSpeed 9.3.

checks.name: Save / restore
checks.observed: Save free camera at 50 m, wind 9.3, swell 1.8, paused. Select Storm and reset camera. Restore recovers those settings and 50.0 m HUD.

checks.name: Quality reload
checks.observed: Balanced to High reload retains wind 9.3, swell 1.8, free camera 0,50,0,0,-12, paused true, time 57.0654.

checks.name: Share
checks.observed: Dialog URL has matching High configuration, camera and time.

checks.name: Hide / show
checks.observed: Cinematic view hides panels, captions and HUD; Show controls restores interface.

checks.name: Capture
checks.observed: Downloaded actual canvas PNG, 1255x884; copy retained as interactive-capture.png. This is not a 1080p benchmark.

checks.name: Panel accessibility state
checks.observed: After source correction and reload, Close controls leaves aria-expanded=false and panel class ui hidden.

checks.name: Camera selector synchronization
checks.observed: After source correction and reload, Reset camera selects surface; 50 m shortcut selects free.

checks.name: Diagnostic control
checks.observed: Water body selection changes displayed water contribution; screenshot inspected.

checks.name: Gallery selectors
checks.observed: Storm / 500 m / 75 degrees loads correct two 1920x1080 PNGs. Special / half-submerged loads matching pair and disables altitude/azimuth controls.

checks.name: Gallery playback
checks.observed: Final skim and storm selections play, reach their final timestamps; start/end browser samples inspected.

checks.name: Console errors
checks.observed: No error entries returned during the final application check.

limits: UI operation is not optical or oceanographic calibration.
